correct_orders: Perform physical examination with focus on abdominal examination
Order complete blood count (CBC), basic metabolic panel, lipase, amylase
Consider imaging studies such as ultrasound or CT scan of the abdomen
Consult general surgery if signs of surgical emergency (e.g., peritonitis, rebound tenderness)
Initiate broad-spectrum antibiotics for suspected intra-abdominal infection
Order: Order: time-sensitive interventions first; (oxygen, IV access, glucose check)
